SELECT 1 AS report_type, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS statistic_period, CONCAT('REPORT', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), r.ent_id) AS report_no, r.ent_id, e.ent_name, '高风险' AS risk_level, e.area_name AS area, e.ent_type_name AS ent_type, MIN(r.create_time) AS begin_time, MAX(r.create_time) AS end_time, COUNT(r.id) AS violation_count
FROM rectify_review r LEFT JOIN enterprise_info e ON r.ent_id = e.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND e.deleted = 0
GROUP BY r.ent_id, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY r.ent_id DESC
